issues.description: Entire compiled script shipped in-band on every compile, then cached again in React state
issues.detail: compile_notebook now reads the full script file and returns it in the RPC response unconditionally, and the frontend stores it in DeployProgressState. Every compile pays O(N) memory and serialization cost regardless of whether the user clicks Download. The file already exists on disk and compiledPath references it; serve it lazily via a download endpoint or anchor instead.

issues.description: Wrong artifact transmitted: script_path (intermediate .kale.py) shipped while UI links to compiled package
issues.detail: kfputils.compile_pipeline produces package_path (.yaml/.tar.gz) which the existing link points at, but the new code reads script_path and derives the download filename from compiledPath. The value sent does not match the identity the user sees next to the button. Pick one artifact and transmit only that, or rename props to make the distinction explicit.

issues.description: File read uses platform-default encoding and has no error handling
issues.detail: open(script_path) lacks encoding='utf-8' and no try/except guards an IOError after compile_pipeline already succeeded. A read failure or non-UTF-8 environment will tank the entire compile response. Pin the encoding and handle read failures so the compile result is not lost.

issues.description: Download control is a bare icon with onClick, not a focusable button
issues.detail: GetAppIcon with onClick is not keyboard-focusable and is not announced as a control by assistive tech; titleAccess alone is insufficient. Wrap in an IconButton or use a real anchor with download attribute so tab order and screen readers work correctly.

issues.description: Filename derivation conflates compiled package path with script content
issues.detail: split('/').pop() on compiledPath always yields a non-empty string so the 'pipeline.kale.py' fallback is dead, and the compiledPath basename labels bytes that are actually the intermediate script. Either send the script's own basename from the backend or guard the missing case earlier.

issues.description: Imperative DOM choreography for download with unstated revoke invariant
issues.detail: createElement/appendChild/click/removeChild/revokeObjectURL is six lines of ceremony that should be a downloadBlob(name, content) helper. The synchronous revokeObjectURL relies on a browser-dependent invariant (download initiated before revoke) that is not documented. Extract a helper and comment the contract.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK: the feature works but the shape is wrong. The compile RPC now ships the entire script content in-band on every call, then the frontend caches a second copy in React state and a third in a Blob URL — four places holding the same bytes with no version semantics, paid eagerly whether the user clicks Download or not. Compounding this, the backend reads the intermediate script_path while the UI labels and links the compiled package, so the wrong artifact is being transmitted. Fixes: serve the file lazily via a download endpoint (or use the existing path with an anchor download attribute), pin UTF-8 encoding with error handling, and make the download control a real keyboard-focusable button.
